data.name: Aleda
data.gender_notes: Aleda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘helos’ meaning ‘help’ or ‘aid’. In Greek mythology, Aleda was a nymph who helped travelers and sailors. In Christianity, Aleda is a name for a faithful and kind companion. The name Aleda carries the meaning “Helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aleda usually hope their child will grow to embody helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A faithful and kind companion on life's journey.
data.etymology: Aleda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aleda total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אלדה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלדה היא שם שפירושו noble, אצילה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלדה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ופירושו אצילה, noble. הוא שם שיכול להיות קשור למילה 'אלד' שפירושו ישיש, זקן. השם אלדה עשוי להיות קשור לנושאים של כבוד, יוקרה ואצילות.

in_greek.name: Αλέδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλέδα έχει τις ρίζες του στην ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει ευγενής, αριστοκρατική. Στην αρχαία Ελλάδα, τα ονόματα ήταν συχνά σύντομες περιγραφές των χαρακτηριστικών ή των ιδιοτήτων του ατόμου. Το όνομα Αλέδα μπορεί να σχετίζεται με την έννοια της ευγένειας και της αξιοπρέπειας.

in_latin.name: Aleda
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Aleda originates from Latin roots and signifies noble, aristocratic. In the context of early Christian tradition, names often reflected one's character or social status. Aleda conveys a sense of dignity, honor, and refinement, aligning with the values of nobility and elegance.

in_english.name: Aleda
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aleda is of Christian origin, derived from Hebrew and Greek roots signifying nobility and elegance. Historically, names like Aleda were chosen for their spiritual significance and positive connotations. In Christian tradition, Aleda symbolizes refinement, dignity, and a connection to aristocratic lineage. The name carries a sense of respect and honor, reflecting the values of nobility and grace.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aleda comes from the Greek word ‘helos’, which holds the meaning of ‘help’ or ‘aid’. In Greek mythology, Aleda was a nymph who offered aid and protection to weary travelers and sailors. This cultural heritage has carried through to the Christian name Aleda, evoking the image of a supportive and compassionate companion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aleda as a Christian name holds significant spiritual meaning, symbolizing the role of a faithful and kind companion. The name is a reminder to offer help and encouragement to those in need, as the ancient nymph did for the Greek travelers and sailors. It also embodies the biblical concept of loving thy neighbor, reflecting the actions and compassion of Jesus Christ towards humanity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aleda, meaning "noble and kind" in Old English, represents the virtuous and compassionate aspect of the Divine Feminine. It is a reminder to embody grace, humility, and strength in our daily lives, reflecting the love and wisdom of the Creator.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Aleda, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Aleda meaning "Helper" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
